Our Financing Strategy and Use of Leverage
paragraphs: Angel Oak Mortgage REIT, Inc. is a real estate finance company focused on acquiring and investing in first and second lien non-QM loans and other mortgage-related assets in the U.S. mortgage market. Our strategy is to make credit-sensitive investments primarily in newly-originated non-QM loans and other mortgage assets that are primarily made to higher-quality borrowers and sourced from the proprietary mortgage lending platform of our affiliate, Angel Oak Mortgage Lending, and other originators through our relationship with Angel Oak Capital. We may also invest in other residential mortgage loans, RMBS, and other mortgage‑related assets as defined in target assets below. Our objective is to generate attractive risk‑adjusted returns for our stockholders, through cash distributions and capital appreciation, across interest rate and credit cycles.

We are a Maryland corporation and commenced operations in September 2018. On June 21, 2021, we completed an initial public offering ("IPO") of our common stock on the New York Stock Exchange ("NYSE"). We are externally managed and advised by our Manager pursuant to the Management Agreement (as defined below).

We have elected to be taxed as a REIT for U.S. federal income tax purposes commencing with our taxable year ended December 31, 2019. Commencing with our taxable year ended December 31, 2019, we believe that we have been organized and operated, and we intend to continue to operate in conformity with the requirements for qualification and taxation as a REIT under the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 (the "Code"). Our qualification as a REIT, and maintenance of such qualification, depends on our ability to meet, on a continuing basis, various complex requirements under the Code relating to, among other things, the sources of our gross income, the composition and values of our assets, our distribution levels and the concentration of ownership of our stock. We also intend to operate our business in a manner that will allow us to maintain our exclusion from regulation as an investment company under the Investment Company Act.

We are externally managed and advised by our Manager, Falcons I, LLC, a registered investment adviser under the Investment Advisers Act of 1940 and an affiliate of Angel Oak Capital, a leading alternative credit manager with market leadership in mortgage credit that includes asset management, lending, and capital markets. Angel Oak Mortgage Lending, an affiliated Angel Oak mortgage origination platform, is a market leader in non‑QM loan production.

Through our relationship with our Manager, we benefit from Angel Oak's vertically integrated platform and in‑house expertise, providing us with the resources that we believe are necessary to generate attractive risk‑adjusted returns for our stockholders. Angel Oak Mortgage Lending provides us with proprietary access to non‑QM loans, as well as transparency over the underwriting process and the ability to acquire loans with our desired credit and return profile. We believe our ability to identify and acquire target assets through the secondary market is bolstered by Angel Oak's experience in the mortgage industry and expertise in structured credit investments. In addition, we believe we have significant competitive advantages due to Angel Oak's analytical investment tools, extensive relationships in the financial community, financing and capital structuring skills, investment surveillance capabilities, and operational expertise.

On October 1, 2025, Angel Oak Companies, an affiliate of our Manager, and Brookfield Asset Management Ltd. ("Brookfield"), closed on a strategic transaction resulting in the beneficial owners of Angel Oak Companies selling approximately 51% of the outstanding beneficial ownership of Angel Oak Companies, and indirectly our Manager, to Brookfield (the "Strategic Transaction"). Angel Oak Companies has advised the Company that the Strategic Transaction is not expected to result in any material change in the day-to-day management of the Company, and will not result in any material changes to the Company's investment objectives and strategies. As part of the Strategic Transaction, Brookfield has the right to acquire additional beneficial ownership in Angel Oak Companies beginning in 2027, which over time could result in Brookfield taking control of the board of directors of Angel Oak Companies.

On October 1, 2025, immediately following the closing of the Strategic Transaction between Angel Oak Companies and Brookfield, the Company, our operating partnership, and our Manager, entered into a new management agreement (the "Management Agreement") to supersede and replace in its entirety the Amended and Restated Management Agreement, dated as if May 1, 2024, previously in effect (the "Prior Management Agreement"). The Management Agreement is substantially and economically similar to the Prior Management Agreement.

Our investment strategy is to make credit-sensitive investments primarily in newly-originated non-QM loans and other mortgage assets that are primarily made to higher-quality borrowers and sourced from Angel Oak Mortgage Lending and other originators through our relationship with Angel Oak Capital. We also may invest in other target assets as described below. We often finance these target assets through various financing lines on, primarily, a short-term basis and ultimately seek to secure long-term securitization funding for substantially all of our target assets. Our objective is to generate attractive risk-adjusted returns for our stockholders, through cash distributions and capital appreciation, across interest rate and credit cycles. We expect to derive our returns primarily from the difference

between the interest we earn on loans we invest in and our cost of capital, as well as the returns from bonds, including risk retention securities, that are retained after securitizing the underlying loan collateral.

Subject to maintaining our qualification as a REIT under the Code, and maintaining our exclusion from regulation as an investment company under the Investment Company Act, we also expect to continue to utilize various derivative instruments and other hedging instruments to mitigate interest rate risk, credit risk, and other risks. For example, we may enter into hedging transactions with respect to interest rate exposure on one or more of our assets or liabilities. Any such hedging transactions could take a variety of forms, including the use of derivative instruments such as interest rate swap contracts, index swap contracts, interest rate cap or floor contracts, futures or forward contracts, and options.
Our Board of Directors has approved the following investment guidelines:
•No investment shall be made that would cause us to fail to qualify as a REIT under the Code;
•No investment shall be made that would cause us or any of our subsidiaries to be regulated as an investment company under the Investment Company Act;
•Our investments will be predominantly in our target assets;

headings: Risks Related to Our Relationship with Our Manager and its Affiliates
Our business may be adversely affected if our reputation, the reputation of our Manager or Angel Oak, or the reputation of counterparties with whom we associate is harmed.

We rely on our Manager to source non-QM loans and other target assets for acquisition by us and Angel Oak Mortgage Lending is under no contractual obligation to sell to us any loans that it originates.
Our Manager's failure to identify and acquire assets that meet our target asset criteria or perform its responsibilities under the Management Agreement could materially and adversely affect us.
We do not own the Angel Oak brand or trademark, but may use the brand and trademark pursuant to the terms of a trademark license agreement with Angel Oak.
Under the Management Agreement, our Manager has a contractually defined duty to us rather than a fiduciary duty.
Risks Related to Our Investment Activities
Our operating results are dependent upon our Manager's ability to source a large volume of desirable non-QM loans and other target assets for our investment on attractive terms.

Angel Oak Mortgage Lending is subject to extensive licensing requirements and regulation, which could materially and adversely affect us if Angel Oak Mortgage Lending does not comply with these requirements.
Currently, we are focused on acquiring and investing in non-QM loans, which may subject us to legal, administrative, regulatory, and other risks, which could materially and adversely affect us.
The non-QM loans in which we invest are subject to increased risks.
The non-QM loans and other residential mortgage loans in which we invest are subject to a risk of default, among other risks.
We may need to foreclose on certain of the residential mortgage loans we acquire, which could result in losses that materially and adversely affect us.

Changes in the fair values of our assets, liabilities, and derivatives can have a material adverse effect on us, including reduced earnings, increased earnings volatility, and volatility in our book value.
paragraphs: An investment in our securities involves significant risks. Before making a decision to invest in our securities, you should carefully consider the following risks in addition to the other information contained in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. The risks discussed in this Annual Report on Form 10-K can materially adversely affect our business, financial condition, liquidity, results of operations and prospects and our ability to make distributions to our stockholders (which we refer to collectively as "materially and adversely affecting us" or having "a material adverse effect on us," and comparable phrases). This could cause the market price of our securities to decline significantly, and you could lose all or part of your investment in our securities. Some statements in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, including statements in the following risk factors, constitute forward-looking statements. Please refer to the section entitled "Special Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements."
We are subject to a number of risks that, if realized, could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, liquidity, results
of operations and prospects and our ability to make distributions to our stockholders. Some of our more significant challenges and risks
include, but are not limited to, the following, which are described in greater detail below:

•We are dependent on our Manager and certain key personnel of Angel Oak who are or may be provided to us through our Manager, and may not find a suitable replacement if our Manager terminates the Management Agreement or such key personnel are no longer available to us.

•There are conflicts of interest in our relationship with Angel Oak, including our Manager, and we may compete with existing and future managed entities of Angel Oak, which may present various conflicts of interest that restrict our ability to pursue certain investment opportunities or take other actions that are beneficial to our business and result in decisions that are not in the best interests of our stockholders.

paragraphs: The following discussion and analysis should be read in conjunction with our historical consolidated financial statements and the notes thereto appearing elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. Some of the information contained in this discussion and analysis, including information with respect to our business strategies, our expectations regarding the future performance of our business, and the other non-historical statements contained herein, are forward-looking statements. Our actual results may differ materially from those anticipated in any forward-looking statements as a result of many factors, including those set forth under "Risk Factors" and "Special Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements" elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K.

Angel Oak Mortgage REIT, Inc. is a real estate finance company focused on acquiring and investing in first and second lien non-QM loans and other mortgage-related assets in the U.S. mortgage market. Our strategy is to make credit-sensitive investments primarily in newly-originated non-QM loans and other mortgage assets that are primarily made to higher-quality borrowers and sourced from the proprietary mortgage lending platform of our affiliate, Angel Oak Mortgage Lending and other originators through our relationship with Angel Oak Capital. We may also invest in other residential mortgage loans, RMBS, and other mortgage-related assets, which, collectively with non-QM loans, we refer to as our target assets. Our objective is to generate attractive risk-adjusted returns for our stockholders, through cash distributions and capital appreciation, across interest rate and credit cycles.

We are externally managed and advised by our Manager, Falcons I, LLC, a registered investment adviser under the Investment Advisers Act of 1940 and an affiliate of Angel Oak Capital, a leading alternative credit manager with market leadership in mortgage credit that includes asset management, lending and capital markets. Angel Oak Mortgage Lending, an affiliated Angel Oak mortgage origination platform, is a market leader in non‑QM loan production.

Through our relationship with our Manager, we benefit from Angel Oak's vertically integrated platform and in‑house expertise, providing us with the resources that we believe are necessary to generate attractive risk‑adjusted returns for our stockholders. Angel Oak Mortgage Lending provides us with proprietary access to non‑QM loans, as well as transparency over the underwriting process and the ability to acquire loans with our desired credit and return profile. We believe our ability to identify and acquire target assets through the secondary market is bolstered by Angel Oak's experience in the mortgage industry and expertise in structured credit investments. In addition, we believe we have significant competitive advantages due to Angel Oak's analytical investment tools, extensive relationships in the financial community, financing and capital structuring skills, investment surveillance capabilities, and operational expertise.

On October 1, 2025, immediately following the closing of the Strategic Transaction between Angel Oak Companies and Brookfield, the Company, our operating partnership, and our Manager, entered into a new Management Agreement to supersede and replace in its entirety the Prior Management Agreement previously in effect. The Management Agreement is substantially and economically similar to the Prior Management Agreement. The Management Agreement reflects two substantive changes from the Prior Management Agreement. The Prior Management Agreement required the Company to reimburse our Manager for a share of the wages, salaries and benefits incurred by our Manager with respect to the Company's Chief Executive Officer and President, based upon the percentage of such person's working time relating to the Company. Under the Management Agreement, this provision was modified to provide that, for so long as Sreeni Prabhu serves as the Company's Chief Executive Officer and President, our Manager will not be entitled to be reimbursed for the costs of his wages, salaries and benefits unless Mr. Prabhu devotes 100% of his working time on matters related to the Company and its subsidiaries (which is not currently the case), and any such reimbursement is approved in advance by at least two-thirds of the independent directors. In addition, under the Management Agreement, with respect to the Company's annual right to decline to renew the Management Agreement without cause upon the affirmative vote of at least two-thirds of the independent directors based upon a determination that the compensation payable to our Manager is not fair, it was clarified that any such determination will take into account amounts sought for expense reimbursement.

We have elected to be taxed as a REIT for U.S. federal income tax purposes commencing with our taxable year ended December 31, 2019. Commencing with our taxable year ended December 31, 2019, we believe that we have been organized and operated, and we intend to continue to operate in conformity with the requirements for qualification and taxation as a REIT under the Code. Our qualification as a REIT, and maintenance of such qualification, depends on our ability to meet, on a continuing basis, various complex requirements under the Code relating to, among other things, the sources of our gross income, the composition and values of our assets, our distribution levels, and the concentration of ownership of our stock. We also intend to operate our business in a manner that will allow us to maintain our exclusion from regulation as an investment company under the Investment Company Act. Our common stock commenced trading on the New York Stock Exchange on June 17, 2021.

We expect to derive our returns primarily from the difference between the interest we earn on loans we invest in and our cost of capital, as well as the returns from bonds, including risk retention securities, that are retained after securitizing the underlying loan collateral.
Overall macroeconomic environment and its effect on us

In 2025, the U.S. Federal Reserve Bank (the "Fed") held the federal funds rate stable through most of the year, and began easing policy in September with its first federal funds rate cut of the year, signaling confidence in an easing of inflationary pressures. Ultimately, three 25 basis point cuts between September and December 2025 culminated in a federal funds rate of 3.50% to 3.75% as of the end of 2025 as compared to 4.25% to 4.50% as of the end of 2024. 2025 was a more constructive general environment compared to 2024; however, while dampened compared to 2024, uncertainty and volatility persisted in 2025 with regard to key inflation and employment data. Overall, the dovish approach was constructive for prospective homebuyers, as mortgage rates decreased in line with the federal funds rate. Additionally, securitization markets demonstrated an improved environment with robust activity and a continued tightening of execution spreads. Expectations are for a steady interest rate environment in 2026 with further inflation moderation and cooling, though positive, economic growth.

The two-year Treasury yield ended at 3.48% as of the end of 2025, demonstrating a decrease of 77 basis points compared to 4.25% as of the end of 2024. The five-year Treasury yield also decreased, ending at 3.73% as of the end of 2025, marking a decrease of 66 basis points compared to 4.39% as of the end of 2024. Similarly the ten-year Treasury yield decreased as well, ending 2025 at 4.17%, a decrease of 41 basis points compared to 4.58% as of the end of 2024. Over the course of 2025, the two-year Treasury saw yields ranging from a high of 4.39% and a low of 3.43%, the five-year Treasury observed yields ranging from a high of 4.61% and a low of 3.55%, and the ten-year saw yields ranging from a high of 4.79% and a low of 3.95%. The Treasury yield curve steepened throughout the course of the year as well, with the spread between the two year and ten year Treasury yield increasing from 32 basis points as of the end of 2024 to 69 basis points as of the end of 2025. All tenors of the Treasury yield saw their annual high rate in January 2025 and their annual low rate in October 2025 before increasing slightly to end the year.

Residential mortgage rates responded alongside the decreases in the federal funds rate, with the average conforming 30-year mortgage rate decreasing by 70 basis points to 6.15% as of the end of 2025 compared to 6.85% as of the end of 2024. Mortgage applications rose in 2025, particularly toward the end of the year, reflecting improved conditions compared to 2024. Residential mortgage rates are key benchmarks for the valuation of our portfolio, and the decreasing rates drove corresponding positive impacts to our asset pricing. Continued purchases of newly originated loans and securitizations of recently originated loans contributed to an increase in the valuations of our residential whole loans and loans in securitization trusts portfolios over the course of 2025, along with a healthy securitization market. We expect to continue to purchase newly originated loans, which should continue to support overall portfolio valuations and securitization execution going forward.

Net Interest Margin ("NIM"). We generated $4.2 million greater net interest income for the year ended December 31, 2025 as compared to the prior year, driven primarily by steady purchases and securitizations of newly originated loans, higher weighted average coupons on our overall investment portfolio, and decreases in funding costs as a percentage of borrowings associated with our residential whole loans portfolio. Our interest income for the year ended December 31, 2025 was $143.7 million compared to $110.4 million in the prior year, and our interest expense for the year ended December 31, 2025 was $102.6 million compared to $73.5 million in the prior year. Our net interest income for the year ended December 31, 2025 increased by 11% versus the prior year.

Net realized loss. Our net realized loss of $10.9 million for the year ended December 31, 2025 was driven by the loss of unamortized premiums associated with an increased rate of loans in our loans held in securitization trusts portfolio that were prepaid during the year, as well as realized losses on forward contracts used to hedge valuation risk in our residential loan portfolio. When valuations of our residential loan portfolio increase, we will typically observe a corresponding negative impact in forward contracts. Our net realized loss of $9.2 million for the year ended December 31, 2024 was primarily driven by our participation in co-mingled securitizations with other Angel Oak entities (AOMT 2024-3 and AOMT 2024-6). Because these securitizations did not result in the consolidation of VIE entities, we recognized a loss on the sale of these loans; however, the realized losses were less than the previous period's unrealized losses for these loans, which drove overall positive GAAP net income for these securitizations.

Net unrealized gain. Our net unrealized gain of $30.8 million for the year ended December 31, 2025 was primarily attributable to $28.6 million of unrealized gains in our residential loans in securitizations trusts and non-recourse securitization obligation portfolio, as well as $3.3 million of unrealized gains in our residential loan portfolio. Gains were driven by a decreasing interest rate environment that led to rebounds in the valuations of lower-coupon securitizations as well as higher marks on new loan purchases and more recent, higher-coupon securitizations.

paragraphs: Angel Oak Mortgage REIT, Inc. 為一間專注於取得並投資美國房貸市場中第一順位及第二順位非Q.M.貸款及其他房貸相關資產的不動產金融公司。我們的策略為主要投資於新發行的非Q.M.貸款及其他房貸資產，這些貸款主要針對信用品質較佳的借款人，並來自我們關係企業Angel Oak Mortgage Lending的專屬房貸貸款平台，以及其他貸款人透過我們與Angel Oak Capital的關係。我們也可能投資於其他住宅房貸貸款、房貸證券化產品（RMBS）及其他房貸相關資產，如目標資產所定義。我們的目標是透過現金分紅及資本增值，在利率與信用週期中為股東產生有吸引力的風險調整後回報。
我們為馬裏蘭州公司，並於2018年9月開始營運。我們於2021年6月21日完成首次公開發行（"IPO"）的普通股，上市地點為紐約證券交易所（"NYSE"）。我們由外部管理機構根據管理協議（如後文所定義）進行外部管理與建議。

我們已選擇以REIT（不動產投資信託）方式納入美國聯邦所得稅目的，自2019年12月31日結算年度起生效。自2019年12月31日結算年度起，我們相信我們已組織並運作，且我們有意繼續運作，符合取得並納入REIT資格及稅收的條件，根據1986年內政部稅收法（"Code"）。我們取得REIT資格，並維持此資格，取決於我們持續符合Code中關於收入來源、資產組成與價值、分紅水準及股權集中度等複雜要求。我們也意圖以符合方式運作業務，使我們能維持不被歸類為投資公司之豁免權，根據投資公司法。

我們由外部管理機構Angel Oak Mortgage Lending的母公司Falcons I, LLC進行外部管理與建議，Falcons I, LLC為根據1940年投資顧問法註冊的投資顧問，且為Angel Oak Capital的關係企業，Angel Oak Capital為一間在房貸信用領域具有市場領導地位的替代性信貸管理公司，業務範疇包括資產管理、貸款及資本市場。Angel Oak Mortgage Lending為一間關係企業的房貸發行平台，為非Q.M.貸款發行的市場領導者。

透過與我們管理機構的關係，我們能受益於Angel Oak的垂直整合平台與內部專業知識，提供我們認為必要的資源，以產生對股東有吸引力的風險調整後回報。Angel Oak Mortgage Lending為我們提供專屬的非Q.M.貸款存取權，以及對貸款審核流程的透明度，並能取得符合我們期望信用與回報特質的貸款。我們相信，透過次級市場取得目標資產的能力，因Angel Oak在房貸產業的經驗與結構性信貸投資的專業知識而獲得強化。此外，我們相信因Angel Oak的分析投資工具、金融界廣泛的關係、融資與資本結構技能、投資監控能力及運營專業知識，我們擁有顯著的競爭優勢。

2025年10月1日，我們管理機構的關係企業Angel Oak Companies與Brookfield Asset Management Ltd.（"Brookfield"）完成一項戰略交易，導致Angel Oak Companies的受益所有人出售約51%的現有受益所有權，並間接出售我們管理機構的權益給Brookfield（"戰略交易"）。Angel Oak Companies已通知本公司，此戰略交易不預期會導致本公司日常管理的任何重大變動，也不會導致本公司投資目標與策略的重大變動。根據戰略交易，Brookfield自2027年起有權取得Angel Oak Companies的更多受益所有權，這可能在長遠中導致Brookfield取得Angel Oak Companies董事會的控制權。
2025年10月1日，戰略交易完成後，本公司、我們的營運合夥企業及我們的管理機構，簽訂一項新的管理協議（"管理協議"），以取代並完全取代先前有效的修正後管理協議（"先前管理協議"），日期為2024年5月1日。管理協議在內容與經濟上與先前管理協議大致相同。

我們的投資策略為主要投資於新發行的非Q.M.貸款及其他房貸資產，這些貸款主要針對信用品質較佳的借款人，並來自Angel Oak Mortgage Lending及其他貸款人透過我們與Angel Oak Capital的關係。我們也可能投資於其他目標資產，如後文所描述。我們經常透過各種融資線，主要以短期方式來資金融通這些目標資產，並最終尋求為我們目標資產的大部分取得長期證券化融資。我們的目標是透過現金分紅及資本增值，在利率與信用週期中為股東產生有吸引力的風險調整後回報。我們預期主要透過以下差異
在我們從投資的貸款所賺取的利息與我們的資金成本之間，以及從債券，包括風險保留證券，所產生的回報，這些回報是在將基礎貸款擔保品證券化後所保留的。

在維持本公司符合 Code 規定的 REIT 資格，以及維持本公司不被視為根據 Investment Company Act 規範的投資公司之條件下，我們也預期會持續使用各種衍生工具及其他避險工具，以降低利率風險、信用風險及其他風險。例如，我們可能針對我們的資產或負債之一或多項的利率風險，進行避險交易。任何此類避險交易可能採取多種形式，包括使用衍生工具，如利率交換合約、指數交換合約、利率上限或下限合約、期貨或遠期合約，以及選擇權。
本公司董事會已批准下列投資指引：
• 不得進行任何投資，導致本公司無法符合 Code 規定的 REIT 資格；
• 不得進行任何投資，導致本公司或任何子公司被規範為根據 Investment Company Act 規範的投資公司；
• 我們的投資將主要集中在目標資產上；

paragraphs: 以下討論與分析應與我們的歷史合併財務報表及該報表所附的附註一併閱讀，這些內容出現在本年度10-K表報告中。部分包含於此討論與分析中的資訊，包括有關我們業務策略、我們對未來業務表現的預期，以及本文中其他非歷史性陳述，屬於向前看的陳述。我們的實際結果可能與任何向前看陳述中預期的結果有重大差異，這是因為許多因素，包括於本年度10-K表報告中其他部分所列的「風險因素」及「向前看陳述特別說明」所致。

Angel Oak Mortgage REIT, Inc. 是一家專注於美國房貸市場，取得並投資於首優及次優非Q.M.貸款及其他房貸相關資產的房地產金融公司。我們的策略是進行信用敏感型投資，主要在新發行的非Q.M.貸款及其他房貸資產，這些資產主要提供給較高品質的借款人，並來自我們關係企業Angel Oak Mortgage Lending的專屬房貸貸款平台及其他貸款人透過我們與Angel Oak Capital的關係。我們也可能投資於其他住宅房貸貸款、RMBS及其它房貸相關資產，這些資產與非Q.M.貸款合稱為我們的目標資產。我們的目標是透過現金分紅及資本增值，在利率與信用週期中為股東產生有吸引力的風險調整後回報。

我們由外部管理及建議，由我們的管理人Falcons I, LLC管理，該管理人為根據1940年投資顧問法註冊的投資顧問，並為Angel Oak Capital的關係企業，Angel Oak Capital為一家在房貸信用領域具有市場領導地位的替代性信貸管理公司，包括資產管理、貸款及資本市場。Angel Oak Mortgage Lending為Angel Oak的關係企業房貸發行平台，為非Q.M.貸款發行的市場領導者。

透過我們與管理人的關係，我們受益於Angel Oak的垂直整合平台及內部專業知識，提供我們認為是產生有吸引力的風險調整後回報所必需的資源。Angel Oak Mortgage Lending為我們提供專屬的非Q.M.貸款存取權，以及對貸款審核流程的透明度，以及取得符合我們期望信用及回報型態的貸款能力。我們相信，我們透過次級市場識別及取得目標資產的能力，因Angel Oak在房貸產業的經驗及結構性信貸投資的專業知識而得到強化。此外，我們相信我們有顯著的競爭優勢，因Angel Oak的分析投資工具、金融界廣泛的關係、融資及資本結構技能、投資監控能力及運營專業知識。

2025年10月1日，於Angel Oak Companies與Brookfield之間的戰略交易完成後，本公司、我們的營運合夥企業及我們的管理人簽訂了一項新的管理協議，以取代並完全取代先前有效的舊管理協議。該管理協議在實質與經濟層面上與舊管理協議相似。該管理協議與舊管理協議相比有兩個實質性的改變。舊管理協議要求本公司償還管理人關於本公司首席執行官及總裁的薪資、工資及福利費用，根據該人工作時間中與本公司相關的比例。根據管理協議，此條款被修改為：只要Sreeni Prabhu擔任本公司首席執行官及總裁，管理人將不會有權獲得其薪資、工資及福利費用的補償，除非Mr. Prabhu將其全部工作時間投入本公司及其子公司事務（目前並非如此），且任何此類補償需經至少兩位獨立董事批准。此外，根據管理協議，關於本公司每年有權在無過失情況下拒絕續約管理協議的權利，經至少兩位獨立董事的明確投票決定，認為管理人應得的報酬不公，則任何此類決定將會考慮管理人所請求的費用補償金額。

我們已選擇以REIT方式納稅，以符合美國聯邦所得稅目的，自我們截至2019年12月31日的納稅年度開始。自我們截至2019年12月31日的納稅年度開始，我們相信我們已組織並運作，且我們意圖繼續運作符合根據稅法取得並保持REIT資格的條件。我們取得REIT資格，並保持此資格，取決於我們持續符合稅法中關於我們毛收入來源、資產組成及價值、分紅水平及股權集中度等複雜要求。我們也意圖以一種方式運作業務，使我們能維持不被視為投資公司而受規範的豁免。我們的普通股於2021年6月17日開始在紐約證券交易所交易。
我們預期主要透過我們投資貸款所賺取的利息與我們的資金成本之間的差額，以及從債券（包括風險保留證券）中取得的回報，來產生回報，這些債券是在將基礎貸款擔保資產證券化後保留的。
總體經濟環境及其對我們的影響

2025 年，美國聯邦儲備銀行（the "Fed"）在大多數時間維持聯邦基金利率不變，並於 9 月開始鬆動政策，進行當年首次聯邦基金利率調降，顯示對通貨膨脹壓力緩和的信心。最終，2025 年 9 月至 12 月間進行了三筆 25 基點的調降，使聯邦基金利率在 2025 年底達到 3.50% 到 3.75%，與 2024 年底的 4.25% 到 4.50% 相較。2025 年整體環境較 2024 年更為正面；然而，與 2024 年相比，2025 年在關鍵通貨膨脹與就業數據方面仍存在不確定性與波動。總體而言，鴿派政策對預期購屋者為正面，因房貸利率隨聯邦基金利率下降。此外，證券化市場表現改善，活動強勁且執行利差持續收窄。預期 2026 年利率環境將維持穩定，通貨膨脹進一步緩和與降溫，不過經濟成長為正面。

兩年期國庫券殖利率在 2025 年底結束時為 3.48%，與 2024 年底的 4.25% 相較，下降了 77 基點。五年期國庫券殖利率也下降，結束 2025 年時為 3.73%，與 2024 年底的 4.39% 相較，下降了 66 基點。同樣地，十年期國庫券殖利率也下降，2025 年結束時為 4.17%，與 2024 年底的 4.58% 相較，下降了 41 基點。在 2025 年期間，兩年期國庫券殖利率波動範圍從高點 4.39% 到低點 3.43%，五年期國庫券殖利率觀察到波動範圍從高點 4.61% 到低點 3.55%，而十年期則從高點 4.79% 到低點 3.95%。國庫券殖利率曲線在全年期間也趨於陡峭，兩年期與十年期國庫券殖利率間的差距從 2024 年底的 32 基點增加至 2025 年底的 69 基點。所有國庫券殖利率期限在 2025 年 1 月達到年度高點，10 月達到年度低點，之後略微回升至年底。

住宅房貸利率隨聯邦基金利率下降而同步調整，平均符合標準的 30 年期房貸利率下降 70 基點至 2025 年底的 6.15%，與 2024 年底的 6.85% 相較。2025 年房貸申請數增加，尤其在年底時更顯著，反映與 2024 年相比改善的條件。住宅房貸利率是我們資產組合評價的關鍵指標，利率下降帶來對資產評價的正面影響。持續購買新發放的貸款與證券化近期新發放的貸款，使我們住宅整貸與貸款在證券化信託組合的評價在 2025 年期間增加，加上健康的證券化市場。我們預期將持續購買新發放的貸款，這應會繼續支持整體資產組合評價與證券化執行。

淨實現損失。我們在 2025 年 12 月 31 日結止年度的淨實現損失為 1,090 萬美元，主要由貸款在證券化信託組閤中因提前償還而導致未償還溢價損失，以及用於對沖住宅貸款組合評價風險的遠期合約實現損失所驅動。當我們住宅貸款組合評價上升時，我們通常會觀察到遠期合約相應的負面影響。我們在 2024 年 12 月 31 日結止年度的淨實現損失為 920 萬美元，主要由我們參與與其他 Angel Oak 企業（AOMT 2024-3 和 AOMT 2024-6）共同發行的證券化交易所導致。因為這些證券化交易未導致 VIE 企業的合併，我們認列這些貸款出售的損失；然而，實現的損失低於前一時期的未實現損失，這驅動整體 GAAP 網路收入為正。
淨未實現獲利。我們在 2025 年 12 月 31 日結止年度的淨未實現獲利為 3,080 萬美元，主要來自住宅貸款在證券化信託組合與非追索權證券化義務組合的未實現獲利 2,860 萬美元，以及住宅貸款組合的未實現獲利 330 萬美元。獲利由利率下降的環境所驅動，導致低票面利率證券化評價回升，以及新貸款購買與近期高票面利率證券化評價提高。

headings: 與我們管理人及其關聯公司之關係相關之風險
若我們聲譽、我們管理人或 Angel Oak 之聲譽，或我們所關聯之交易對手之聲譽受損，可能對我們之業務造成不利影響。
我們依賴管理人尋找非 QM 按揭貸款及其他目標資產以供我們及 Angel Oak 收購，而 Angel Oak Mortgage Lending 並無合同義務向我們出售其發行之貸款。
管理人未能識別並取得符合我們目標資產標準之資產，或未能履行管理協議下之責任，可能對我們造成重大且不利之影響。
我們並未擁有 Angel Oak 品牌或商標，但可依 trademarks license agreement 與 Angel Oak 之條款使用該品牌與商標。
根據管理協議，管理人對我們負有合同上之義務，而非信託義務。
與我們投資活動相關的風險
我們的營運成果取決於我們經理能否以有吸引力的條件取得大量合適的非QM貸款及其他目標資產進行投資。
Angel Oak Mortgage Lending 面臨嚴格的許可要求與監管，若 Angel Oak Mortgage Lending 未能遵守這些要求，可能會對我們造成重大且不利的影響。
目前，我們專注於取得並投資非QM貸款，這可能會使我們面臨法律、行政、監管及其他風險，這些風險可能會對我們造成重大且不利的影響。
我們投資的非QM貸款面臨更高的風險。
我們投資的非QM貸款及其他住宅抵押貸款面臨違約風險，以及其他風險。
我們可能需要對部分取得的住宅抵押貸款進行拍賣，這可能會導致損失，對我們造成重大且不利的影響。
我們資產、負債及衍生工具的公允價值變動可能對我們造成重大不利影響，包括利潤減少、利潤波動增加及帳面價值波動。
paragraphs: 投資本公司證券涉及重大風險。在決定投資本公司證券前，您應仔細考慮下列風險，以及本年度報告表10-K所載其他資訊。本年度報告表10-K所討論的風險，可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、流動性、營運成果與前景，以及本公司對股東發放分紅的能力產生重大且不利的影響（我們 collectively 稱為 "重大且不利影響" 或 "對本公司產生重大不利影響"，並包含類似用語）。這可能會導致本公司證券的市場價格大幅下跌，您可能損失全部或部分投資於本公司證券的金額。本年度報告表10-K中的一些陳述，包括下列風險因素中的陳述，屬於展望性陳述。請參閱標題為 "特別注意展望性陳述" 的部分。
本公司面臨許多風險，若實現，可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、流動性、營運成果與前景，以及本公司對股東發放分紅的能力產生重大且不利的影響。
本公司較重要的挑戰與風險
包括，但不僅限於下列，以下將更詳細說明：
•本公司依賴我們的經理人及安潔奧克的某些關鍵人員，這些人員可能是或可能透過我們的經理人提供給我們，若我們的經理人終止管理協議或這些關鍵人員無法再提供給我們，我們可能無法找到合適的替代者。
•我們與安潔奧克的關係中存在利益衝突，包括我們的經理人，我們可能與安潔奧克現有及未來管理的機構競爭，這可能會產生各種利益衝突，限制我們追求某些投資機會或採取對本公司業務有益的行動，並導致做出對股東最有利的決策。
